method: Researched Nov. 26, 2026 from team and contract reporting (each player lists sources). Roles per season: elite = top-3 at the position, lead = top-8, starter = top-16 RB / top-12 QB and TE / top-24 WR, flex = committee back, bridge QB, WR3 or a lower-end TE, backup, none. Contract years for most rookie deals are the standard length for the draft round unless noted.

players.notes: He was a 2025 second-round pick, so his rookie deal runs through 2028. QJ's option runs out after 2027, which opens the outside-WR2 role next to McConkey for 2028.

sources.title: Tre Harris looking at expanded role in 2026

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.status_2026: Out for 2026 after tearing his ACL in August (1.2 PPG).
players.notes: He was a 2025 second-round pick (#34), so his deal runs through 2028. While he was out, HOU traded for Marvin Harrison Jr., which crowds the WR2 role behind Collins. Expect 2027 to be a recovery year.

sources.title: Texans WR Jayden Higgins (torn ACL) out for 2026
